'''Spicy Gargon gumbo''' was the [[Soup/Legends|soup]] of the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] for [[Taungsday/Legends|Taungsday]] at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where it was served for 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]<ref name="Dex" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> The spicy dish shared its name with<ref name="Dex" /> the planet [[Gargon/Legends|Gargon]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|323|Gargon}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Spicy Gargon gumbo was introduced in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] and formatted as an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Dex" />
